plugins.name: mailchannels
plugins.description: MailChannels Email API sends transactional email from a single app or a multi-tenant product, including password resets, sign-in links, verification codes, receipts, invitations and notifications. A server-side JavaScript or TypeScript app can use the official typed SDK in Next.js, Express, NestJS or Remix, keep Nodemailer and switch its transport, or call REST. Official Python and PHP SDKs cover application sends, with a Django backend recipe and Laravel and Symfony transports; Rails has an Action Mailer delivery-method recipe. Every API send reports delivery, bounce and complaint events through signed webhooks, with managed DKIM, suppressions and one-click unsubscribe. Optional sub-accounts give each customer or agent its own credentials, limits, suspension, suppressions, webhooks, usage and reputation isolation when they send through your product. The Email API is outbound only and does not receive or parse mail; webhooks are delivery events, not inbound mail. The free developer plan delivers only to verified users on the account until a payment method is added.
